finding.text: There is no requirements.md in the task folder. The only record of the ask is the title in session.jsonl line 1 ("Two jobs, for the owner…"), which never says what the two jobs were. A fresh agent can't check the work against the owner's words from this folder. Add a requirements.md that quotes the relayed ask: report plan usage, and give the cloud session a tool to read usage itself.
The new `check_usage` tool isn't indexed. `Servex/doc/tools-map.md:18` lists `system_health` but not `check_usage`, and the minion's own log (session.jsonl, 18:21:26) says so too. Add it to that row.

The new `Server/UsagePace.mjs` and `Server/UsagePace.test.mjs` are listed in neither `Server/readme.md` nor `Server/doc/scripts.md`. `.claude/skills/check-claude-usage/SKILL.md:8` still names only `usage-now.mjs`. Add one line for the module and its test, and one line in the skill naming the `check_usage` tool, for sessions that can't run node (the cloud voice agent).

When usage.json has no weekly limit, `Usage.status()` (`Servex/Usage.js`, status) still returns `ok: true`, with NaN numbers and `advice: "room to spend"`. Verified: `usage_pace({})` gives `gone: NaN, pace: NaN, advice: 'room to spend'`. A cloud agent would read that as permission to spend. Return `ok: false` when `week.used` or `week.gone` is not finite.

`window_pace` reads `limit.resets_at` without `?.` (`Server/UsagePace.mjs:9`), so a null limit throws. Today `usage_pace` never passes one: week falls back to an object, and session is guarded. Only a future caller could hit this.

The refactor keeps the old behaviour. `usage-now.mjs` prints the same two lines and keeps exit code 2 when over pace, `over_pace` keeps its `seven_day` fallback and its "unreadable means not over" rule, and `node Server/UsagePace.test.mjs` passes in worktree/qf-5 (commit 0dfaaeb7b). One pace rule in one module is the simpler shape.

The work isn't merged yet: it is still on worktree/qf-5, and the tool only appears after a Servex restart (session.jsonl, 18:32:33). The task folder has no landing outcome (past-work.md: "no outcome logged").
